verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS commerce platform like Square, so the axis applies. The pack documents per-resource APIs, such as retrieving location information, reviewing inventory changes and listing payouts, but these are developer building blocks for constructing an export. Nothing documents a first-party bulk export of all account data in open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON) or an account-exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
